This container includes the MII interface configuration between
an Ethernet Controller and the Ethernet Transceiver. If this
container is configured the EthTrcv shall call Eth_WriteMii / Eth_
ReadMii API to access the hardware ethernet tranceiver. Note:
In case of external MACPHY use this parameter may be enabled.
EthTrcvSwitchInterface
0..1
This container includes the Switch interface configuration
between an Ethernet Switch and an Ethernet Transceiver. If this
container is configured the EthTrcv shall call EthSwt_WriteTrcv
Register / EthSwt_WriteTrcvRegister API to access the hardware
ethernet transceiver.
